gain.statistic: mean per-scenario rubric score, treatment arm minus vanilla, paired by scenario

secondBatch.statistic: the same difference on a second, independent batch of runs

qualityLoss.statistic: quality pack score, treatment arm minus vanilla, on a 0 to 1 scale
qualityLoss.note: Passes when the treatment arm scores no lower than vanilla minus noiseMargin. The default 0.05 is a provisional value; replace it with the spread measured between repeated runs of the same arm before the freeze.

reportOnly: expert check: whether the owner agrees the surviving rules are worth following
layout swap: whether the gain survives swapping the order and layout of the answers shown to the judges
